description: gtfs_DKBUS_lignes is a dataset listed in Open Data Dunkerque Agglomération, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Communauté urbaine de Dunkerque. Liste des arrêts de bus de la communauté urbaine de Dunkerque, tels que présentés dans le GTFS publié sur. Coverage: Dunkirk urban community. The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are bus, ligne de bus. The portal shows 20 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-dunkerque-agglo-fr-portal.
